fix.notes: The hype message is only shown when `in_rotation` is True and `runs > 0`, so the page is unchanged outside of active rotation. The `asyncio.run()` call is synchronous-safe because the Flask route handler is sync; if the site ever migrates to async Flask, this would need revisiting. The function may call Redis and external services (card ranks), which could add latency on the first page load after a rotation run.

## What was wrong The `/rotation` page showed run stats and card data but omitted the same hype summary message that the Discord bot posts after each rotation run. Visitors had to check Discord to see which cards were newly confirmed legal, newly eliminated, or just got their first hit. ## What changed - **`decksite/views/rotation.py`**: Added `asyncio.run(rotation.rotation_hype_message(True))` in `Rotation.__init__` when `in_rotation` is True and runs > 0. The Discord-format URL (``) is stripped via regex since the user is already on the rotation page. - **`decksite/templates/rotation.mustache`**: Added `{{#hype_message}}
{{hype_message}}
{{/hype_message}}` directly after the rotation status line, so the hype summary appears at the top of the page when rotation is active. ## Validation - `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (mypy clean on the touched file) - `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 845 passed, 1 skipped Fixes #12282
